subject: CAIQ embedded SDK telemetry: control assertions + synthetic testcase evidence request
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novusbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tracy Huang <procurement@novusbank.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ: SDK telemetry claims + synthetic testcases

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for taking this. NovusBank security is working through your CAIQ submission and we have a follow-up ask focused on the embedded SDK (mobile/web) telemetry collection and runtime trace evidence. Specifically:

- A CAIQ control-to-assertion mapping for any CSA controls that reference telemetry, runtime logging, key rotation, and tenant isolation related to the SDK.
- Compact synthetic testcases (scripts + expected outputs) we can run inside our pre-prod environment to validate telemetry collection, sampling, and residency claims.
- Step-by-step run instructions and any small sample artifacts (redacted logs, sample trace files).

We'd like to review artifacts in the next week to keep our audit timetable. At minimum, security needs: CAIQ mapping (xlsx/pdf), 2-3 synthetic tests with README, and representative logs. If you have a lightweight harness we can run (docker or node script) that would be ideal.

Attachments: sdk-telemetry-exemplar.tar.gz (sample logs + small harness), caiq-control-mapping-request.xlsx (their internal template)

Can you confirm scope (hosted API vs private deploy behavior differences) and a target delivery date?

Alex Mercer
Director, Security Engineering
NovusBank
alex.mercer@novusbank.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novusbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ: SDK telemetry claims + synthetic testcases

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask, we can get this over. Quick clarifying notes so we scope correctly:

1) Scope: we will provide a single CAIQ crosswalk calling out where SDK telemetry maps to CSA controls. We'll include notes where Hosted API behaviour differs from Private (VPC/HSM) deployments (residency, keystore handling).

2) Testcases: Marcus will author 3 small synthetic tests (mobile & web sample) that: exercise telemetry emission, verify prefix/KV cache telemetry, and validate a sampling/retention scenario. Tests will be runnable via a small Node harness (no customer secrets).

3) Evidence: Kimberly will collate representative redacted logs, screenshots of runtime trace, and control-level artifact references. We'll call out exact file paths in the CAIQ mapping.

Target: can your team accept a delivery by Tuesday 2026-12-22 EOD? If yes, we'll send a Draft CAIQ map + harness README by Monday morning and then the full artifact bundle (zipped) by Tue.

Deliverables we'll produce:
- CAIQ-mapping-draft.pdf (control assertions + notes)
- test-harness-readme.md (how to run the synthetic tests)
- sdk-telemetry-exemplar.tar.gz (sample logs, redacted)
- action-item-sheet.csv (owner + ETA)

Let us know if you need the artifacts over secure transfer or a signed NDA/SoW.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
